title: Asymptotic behavior of some stochastic models in population dynamics: a Hamilton-Jacobi approach
summary: In this paper, we investigate the asymptotic behavior of individual-based models describing the evolution of a population structured by a real trait, subject to selection and mutation. We consider two different sets of assumptions: first, the case of critical or subcritical branching population processes in a regime combining a discretization of the trait space, small mutations, large time and large initial population size, where we are able to characterize using a Hamilton-Jacobi approach, the survival set of the population, and the asymptotic of the logarithmic scaling of subpopulation…
